newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds lower, buyers unmoved.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds lower, buyers unmoved.

text.p: High protein soymeal offers were as much as four stg a tonne lower on the UK meals and feeds market on Tuesday, but buyers were showing no interest, traders said.
The market felt that Chicago had over-reacted to forecasts of hot dry weather in the main soybean growing areas.
"We should be used to this, it happens every year in Chicago," said one broker.
High protein soymeal ex-mill was offered unchanged to four stg down with stores making similar reductions.
"Buyers are showing no interest whatsoever," said another broker.
All other sectors of the market were unchanged.
